title: A second DHCP server is answering on this segment

chain.why: A DHCP server answered on a segment that already had one. Every client that renews from here on gets whichever of them replies first.

evidence.describe: a second DHCP server appeared on 10.99.0.99, handing out 10.99.0.99 as the gateway

advice: Find the switch port the new server's hardware address is learned on and shut it. Almost always a consumer router plugged in the wrong way round, with its LAN side facing the network. Until it is off, clients will keep taking its addresses and its gateway at random.
